fitting."],"overturn_conditions":["If the task class is closed (all possible cases covered by the checklist), OOD probes are impossible and the analogy fails.","If the expert also fails on OOD probes, generalization.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Within the distribution the checklist was designed for, panelists may comply with checklist rules without extracting the underlying causal structure. This produces identical accuracy to genuine understanding on in-distribution items. The two are distinguishable only when the evaluation includes probe items that are out-of-distribution relative to the checklist's design but still objectively scorable: genuine understanding generalizes; mere compliance degrades sharply.
